items.source: Creates a ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.EvaluatingValueExpressionQueryRewriter from the current one and the given QueryMethodValueEvaluationContextAccessor.
items.translation: 基于当前对象和给定的 QueryMethodValueEvaluationContextAccessor 创建一个 ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.EvaluatingValueExpressionQueryRewriter。

items.source: Creates a new ValueExpressionQueryRewriter using the given ValueExpressionParser and rewrite functions.
items.translation: 使用给定的ValueExpressionParser和重写函数创建一个新的 ValueExpressionQueryRewriter。

items.source: Creates a new EvaluatingValueExpressionQueryRewriter using the given ValueExpressionDelegate and rewrite functions.
items.translation: 使用给定的ValueExpressionDelegate和重写函数创建一个新的 EvaluatingValueExpressionQueryRewriter。

items.source: parameterNameSource - function to generate parameter names. Typically, a function of the form (index, expression) -> "__some_placeholder_" + index.
items.translation: `parameterNameSource` - 用于生成参数名称的函数。通常形式为 `(index, expression) -> "__some_placeholder_" + index`。

items.source: replacementSource - function to generate replacements. Typically, a concatenation of the prefix and the parameter name such as String::concat.
items.translation: replacementSource - 用于生成替换内容的函数。通常是将前缀与参数名称进行拼接，例如 String::concat。

items.source: Result of the parse process is a ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.ParsedQuery which provides the transformed query string. Alternatively and preferred one may provide a QueryMethodValueEvaluationContextAccessor via withEvaluationContextAccessor(QueryMethodValueEvaluationContextAccessor) which will yield the more powerful ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.EvaluatingValueExpressionQueryRewriter.
items.translation: 解析过程的结果是一个 ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.ParsedQuery，它提供了转换后的查询字符串。或者，更优的做法是通过 withEvaluationContextAccessor(QueryMethodValueEvaluationContextAccessor) 提供一个 QueryMethodValueEvaluationContextAccessor，这将生成功能更强大的 ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.EvaluatingValueExpressionQueryRewriter。

items.source: Parses a query string, identifies the contained Value expressions, replaces them with bind parameters and offers a Map from those bind parameters to the value expression.
items.translation: 解析查询字符串，识别其中包含的值表达式，将其替换为绑定参数，并提供一个从这些绑定参数到值表达式的Map。

items.source: Evaluates Value expressions as detected by ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.ParsedQuery based on parameter information from a method and parameter values from a method call.
items.translation: 根据方法中的参数信息和方法调用中的参数值，评估由ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.ParsedQuery检测到的 Value 表达式。

items.source: a EvaluatingValueExpressionQueryRewriter instance to rewrite queries and extract parsed ValueExpressions.

items.source: A ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.ParsedQuery which makes the query with Value Expressions replaced by bind parameters and a map from bind parameter to Value Expression available. Guaranteed to be not null.
items.translation: 一个 `ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.ParsedQuery`，其中查询已用绑定参数替换 Value 表达式，并提供从绑定参数到 Value 表达式的映射。保证不为 null。

items.source: expressionParser - the expression parser to use.

items.translation: query - 包含上述格式中所述值表达式的查询。不得为 null。

items.source:
A ValueExpressionQueryRewriter is able to detect Value expressions in a query string and to replace them
with bind variables.
items.translation: ValueExpressionQueryRewriter 能够检测查询字符串中的 Value 表达式，并将其替换为绑定变量。

items.source:
ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.EvaluatingValueExpressionQueryRewriter rewriter = ValueExpressionQueryRewriter
                .of(valueExpressionParser, (counter, expression) -> String.format("__$synthetic$__%d", counter), String::concat)
                .withEvaluationContextAccessor(evaluationContextProviderFactory);

ValueExpressionQueryRewriter.QueryExpressionEvaluator evaluator = rewriter.parse(query, queryMethod.getParameters());

evaluator.evaluate(objects).forEach(parameterMap::addValue);
